north_star: Let users control whether dropped attachments become links or embeds by file extension.
wedge: Intercept external file drops in Markdown editors and insert a configured link or embed while preserving native attachment storage and link format.
target_user: Obsidian users who want predictable attachment links
core_promise: Every configured extension lands as the selected link, embed, or native default form.
product_principles: Use only public APIs and never modify existing attachments.
non_goals: Replace Obsidian attachment storage or become a file manager.
success_metrics: PDF drops produce links while image drops produce embeds under the default settings.
